claim_boundary: V19CJ defines source-state strata; it does not select a cluster and is not evidence for Sigma Gravity.
X-ray concentration, centroid shift, power ratios, asymmetry and profile shape are baryonic source diagnostics, not lensing targets.
The signed delta boundary and multimetric directions are fixed before any candidate value is read.
A balanced shortlist must survive source-completeness filtering without using lensing quality as a replacement criterion.
Solar-System work remains a later hard veto and is not optimized here.

crossmatch_rule.ambiguous_matches: exclude pending an independently sourced alias resolution
crossmatch_rule.method: case-insensitive catalog identifier and curated catalog-alias equality after punctuation normalization; no nearest-coordinate matching and no lensing-derived identity
crossmatch_rule.unmatched_candidates: remain clean reserves but cannot enter the morphology-balanced shortlist

forbidden_selection_axes: inferred halo mass, concentration, centroid, ellipticity or orientation
Sigma prediction, residual or parameter preference

failure_and_fallback_rules.fewer_than_3_secure_relaxed_or_disturbed: do not relabel intermediate systems; expand the externally selected clean source frame or register a second catalog
failure_and_fallback_rules.fewer_than_8_finite_clean_crossmatches: do not relax thresholds; preregister a second independent X-ray morphology catalog before reading it
failure_and_fallback_rules.source_completeness_removes_balance: do not choose by lensing quality; enlarge the metadata pool until the frozen balance is restored

multimetric_consistency_rule.discordant_extreme: retain as a dedicated source-complexity flag but do not use as a secure relaxed/disturbed anchor
multimetric_consistency_rule.disturbed_direction: lower logc, higher logw, higher logP3/P0
multimetric_consistency_rule.relaxed_direction: higher logc, lower logw, lower logP3/P0
multimetric_consistency_rule.secondary_catalog_role: report agreement or disagreement without replacing the primary state or changing a threshold
multimetric_consistency_rule.secure_disturbed_confirmation: primary secure_disturbed and at least two of logc<=sample_median_logc, logw>=sample_median_logw, logP3/P0>=sample_median_logP3/P0
multimetric_consistency_rule.secure_relaxed_confirmation: primary secure_relaxed and at least two of logc>=sample_median_logc, logw<=sample_median_logw, logP3/P0<=sample_median_logP3/P0

primary_state_rule.published_boundary: Yuan and Han define delta as signed distance from the kappa-log10(alpha) demarcation, with lower delta more relaxed and higher delta more disturbed

primary.name: Yuan and Han 2020 Chandra dynamical-state catalog

secondary.name: Zhang et al. 2023 Planck clusters in the LOFAR sky morphology catalog
secondary.role: independent Planck-name concentration and centroid-shift cross-check where available
